disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating or attempting to violate, directly or indirectly assisting in or abetting the violation of, or conspiring to violate any provision of the optometry chapter or board regulations.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violating or attempting to violate, directly or indirectly assisting in or abetting the violation of, or conspiring to violate any provision of this chapter or any of the rules and regulations adopted by the board pursuant to this chapter.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Gross negligence in the practice of optometry.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Gross negligence.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Repeated negligent acts (two or more negligent acts or omissions).
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Repeated negligent acts. To be repeated, there must be two or more negligent acts or omissions.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Incompetence in the practice of optometry.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Incompetence.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Commission of fraud, misrepresentation, or any act involving dishonesty or corruption substantially related to the qualifications, functions, or duties of an optometrist.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The commission of fraud, misrepresentation, or any act involving dishonesty or corruption, that is substantially related to the qualifications, functions, or duties of an optometrist.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Any action or conduct that would have warranted the denial of a license.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Any action or conduct that would have warranted the denial of a license.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Use of advertising relating to optometry that violates the advertising provisions of law.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The use of advertising relating to optometry that violates Section 651 or 17500.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Denial, revocation, suspension, restriction, or other disciplinary action against a health care professional license by another state, territory, or governmental agency.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Denial of licensure, revocation, suspension, restriction, or any other disciplinary action against a health care professional license by another state or territory of the United States, by any other governmental agency, or by another California health care professional licensing board.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Procuring the optometry license by fraud, misrepresentation, or mistake.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Procuring his or her license by fraud, misrepresentation, or mistake.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Making or giving any false statement or information in connection with the application for issuance of a license.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Making or giving any false statement or information in connection with the application for issuance of a license.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of a felony or of any offense substantially related to the qualifications, functions, and duties of an optometrist.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Conviction of a felony or of any offense substantially related to the qualifications, functions, and duties of an optometrist, in which event the record of the conviction shall be conclusive evidence thereof.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Administering to oneself any controlled substance or using dangerous drugs or alcohol to a dangerous or injurious extent, or to an extent that impairs ability to practice safely.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Administering to himself or herself any controlled substance or using any of the dangerous drugs specified in Section 4022, or using alcoholic beverages to the extent, or in a manner, as to be dangerous or injurious to the person applying for a license or holding a license under this chapter

disciplinary_grounds.description: Committing or soliciting a sexually related crime substantially related to the duties of an optometrist, or committing any act of sexual abuse, misconduct, or relations with a patient.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Committing or soliciting an act punishable as a sexually related crime, if that act or solicitation is substantially related to the qualifications, functions, or duties of an optometrist.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Repeated acts of excessive prescribing, furnishing, or administering of controlled substances or dangerous drugs, or repeated acts of excessive treatment.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Repeated acts of excessive prescribing, furnishing, or administering of controlled substances or dangerous drugs specified in Section 4022, or repeated acts of excessive treatment.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Repeated acts of excessive use of diagnostic or therapeutic procedures or diagnostic or treatment facilities.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Repeated acts of excessive use of diagnostic or therapeutic procedures, or repeated acts of excessive use of diagnostic or treatment facilities.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Prescribing, furnishing, or administering controlled substances or drugs, or providing treatment, without a good faith prior examination of the patient and optometric reason.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The prescribing, furnishing, or administering of controlled substances or drugs specified in Section 4022, or treatment without a good faith prior examination of the patient and optometric reason.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to maintain adequate and accurate records relating to the provision of services to patients.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The failure to maintain adequate and accurate records relating to the provision of services to his or her patients.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Performing, or holding oneself out as being able to perform, or offering to perform, professional services beyond the scope of the optometry license.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Performing, or holding oneself out as being able to perform, or offering to perform, any professional services beyond the scope of the license authorized by this chapter.

disciplinary_grounds.description: The practice of optometry without a valid, unrevoked, unexpired license.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The practice of optometry without a valid, unrevoked, unexpired license.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Employing, directly or indirectly, any suspended or unlicensed optometrist to perform work requiring an optometry license.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The employing, directly or indirectly, of any suspended or unlicensed optometrist to perform any work for which an optometry license is required.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Permitting another person to use the licensee's optometry license for any purpose.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Permitting another person to use the licensee's optometry license for any purpose.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Altering with fraudulent intent a license issued by the board, or using a fraudulently altered license, permit, certification, or registration.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Altering with fraudulent intent a license issued by the board, or using a fraudulently altered license, permit certification or any registration issued by the board.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Except for good cause, the knowing failure to protect patients by failing to follow infection control guidelines of the board, risking transmission of bloodborne infectious diseases.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Except for good cause, the knowing failure to protect patients by failing to follow infection control guidelines of the board, thereby risking transmission of bloodborne infectious diseases from optometrist to patient, from patient to patient, or from patient to optometrist.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure or refusal to comply with a request for clinical records of a patient accompanied by patient's written authorization within 15 days.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure or refusal to comply with a request for the clinical records of a patient, that is accompanied by that patient's written authorization for release of records to the board, within 15 days of receiving the request and authorization

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to refer a patient to an appropriate physician and surgeon if examination indicates substantial likelihood of pathology requiring physician attention.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to refer a patient to an appropriate physician and surgeon if an examination of the eyes indicates a substantial likelihood of any pathology that requires the attention of that physician and surgeon.

drug_authority.value: TPA-certified optometrists may use or prescribe topical and oral prescription and nonprescription therapeutic pharmaceutical agents that are not controlled substances and not antiglaucoma agents (unless also glaucoma-certified); may prescribe oral analgesic controlled substances codeine with compounds, hydrocodone with compounds, and tramadol limited to three days with referral; may use or prescribe antiglaucoma agents if also glaucoma-certified; may administer immunizations if also immunization-certified.

surgery_prohibited.quote: Performing surgery is excluded from the practice of optometry. "Surgery" means any act in which human tissue is cut, altered, or otherwise infiltrated by any means.

surgery_definition.value: Any act in which human tissue is cut, altered, or otherwise infiltrated by any means. It does not mean an act that solely involves the administration or prescribing of a topical or oral therapeutic pharmaceutical.
